thread:
sara_finance: FYI - DeltaHealth sent renewal INV-2024-5423 and it looks off. Two platform fee lines and an unexpected support band bump.

mike_sales: Can you paste the invoice lines? I want to confirm before contacting AE.

sara_finance: Lines pulled from PDF: 
```
Line 10: Platform fee - Private deployment - $120,000
Line 11: Platform fee - OnPrem addendum - $30,000
Line 18: Support - Premium - $45,000
Total = $195,000
```
Contract DeltaHealth_SOW_v3 specifies single platform fee $120k and Support = Standard $20k. No signed amendment for Premium.

tina_accounting: Invoice added to approvals queue. Billing contact is billing@deltahealth.com. I can place a hold.

oliver_finops: Do we have a signed SOW for the $30k addendum? If it was only a quote it shouldn't be billed.

mike_sales: CLM shows MIG-2023-09 was a quote, status = not executed. No countersignature.

rebecca_se: We did assist with high-severity incidents in Nov (KV cache warmup). No SLA upgrade was executed.

billing-bot: System note: INV-2024-5423 created 2024-11-02. Audit flag: support-band change without signed amendment.

sara_finance: Action plan: 1) Tina put invoice on hold. 2) Mike confirm whether addendum signed. 3) Rebecca collect incident logs. 4) Finance to propose credit if charges invalid.

tina_accounting: Invoice put on hold in billing system. Added "billing dispute - pending validation".

mike_sales: Confirmed MIG-2023-09 was never signed. I'll reach out to DeltaHealth AE now and cc Legal.

rebecca_se: I'll export ticket IDs and timestamps for Nov 20-26 incidents. No contractual SLA change documented.

oliver_finops: Two options: issue credit for $30k addendum and keep support as Standard, or obtain retroactive signed amendment for Premium with back-billing. Finance prefers credit to close quickly.

sara_finance: Sales has until EOD tomorrow to secure signature, otherwise we issue a credit.

mike_sales: Reached AE via DM. They confirm no signature and prefer an immediate credit to the current invoice. Also requested a small goodwill SLA credit.

oliver_finops: Recommend goodwill cap $5k per incident group. If we apply $5k goodwill for the Nov incidents, total credit = $35k. Finance approves if Sales documents acceptance.

tina_accounting: I'll prepare credit memo CM-2024-114 and corrected invoice INV-2024-5423R and route for approval. Note: apply offset to same invoice run to avoid duplicate revenue recognition. Looping in RevOps.

mike_sales: I'll get written acceptance from DeltaHealth (email confirmation) agreeing to credit and waiving future back-billing for this window.

sara_finance: Thanks team. Please post the signed acceptance and CM numbers here once complete. :thumbsup:
